Your Tasks
 * Technical Ownership: Responsibility for technical direction, architectural alignment and overall delivery coherence across a large enterprise engagement (including planning and monitoring projects, budgets and operational metrics).
 * Cross-Team Collaboration: Close alignment with multiple engineering teams to ensure shared understanding, consistent quality and smooth execution.
 * Technical Sparring: High-level exchange with engineers, architects and senior stakeholders to bring clarity into complex technical environments.
 * Enterprise Navigation: Confident handling of large organisations, legacy landscapes and multi-layered stakeholder structures.
 * Capability Alignment: Identification of new opportunities, expansion within the engagement to enable cross- and upselling - matching them with the right SQUER expertise.
 * Stakeholder Partnership: Direct interaction with key client stakeholders up to C-Level, providing technical orientation and decision-support.
 * Delivery Stability: Structured oversight of capacity, forecasting and budgets to ensure a reliable, high-quality delivery environment

Your Qualifications
 * Technical Depth: Strong background in software engineering, architecture or enterprise-scale systems, with the seniority to guide others.
 * Enterprise Experience: Familiarity with large organizational structures such as insurance or banking, and their operational dynamics.
 * Systems Understanding: Ability to grasp complex technical landscapes, dependencies, risks and constraints in multi-team setups.
 * AI-native: You actively use AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality, or you're eager to start.

 * Communication Excellence: Ability to articulate technical topics clearly, confidently, and audience-appropriately in German and English.
 * Collaborative Influence: Leadership through clarity, alignment, and technical guidance rather than formal authority - enabling teams and stakeholders to move in the same direction.
 * Partnership Mindset: Commitment to long-term collaboration, team cohesion, and sustainable technical impact.

Your Benefits

Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:
 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.

 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

jobs.description:
The University of Klagenfurt is pleased to announce an open faculty position in the Department of Economics, Analytics and Operations Research within the Faculty of Management, Economics & Law, in compliance with the provisions of Art. 98 (open-ended) or Art. 98 (limited to 6 years) of the Austrian Universities Act: 1 Full Professor of Production Management Referenzcode: 239/03-PERS/26 

Full Professor of Production Management

This is a full-time position. Whether the position will be implemented in compliance with the provisions of Art. 98 Austrian Universities Act as open-ended or limited to 6 years will be decided during the course of the appointment procedure, based on candidate qualifications and experience.

The professorship will be embedded in the Department of Economics, Analytics and Operations Research (EAOR, https://www.aau.at/en/economics/%29 within the Faculty of Management, Economics & Law (https://www.aau.at/wr). We are looking for a highly qualified and (in line with academic seniority) internationally recognised academic with high engagement in developing and sustaining an ambitious and innovative research programme.

The duties of the position include:

-Representing the fields of Production and/or Logistics Management in research and teaching

-Representing the EAOR-Department's Operations Research group in research and teaching

-Teaching in relevant study programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctoral level in English and German, including the supervision of academic theses. German language skills are not a prerequisite, but teaching ability and proficiency in German (Level B2) are expected within two years after appointment

-Acquisition and management of competitive research funding

-Collaborating with colleagues across the university and with external partners

-Advising and mentoring students and early career researchers

-Contributing to university governance and academic self-administration

-Engaging in third mission activities and public outreach

Required qualifications:

-Habilitation or equivalent qualification in a relevant field: Operations Research, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Management Science, Business Administration, or related fields

-Doctoral degree or PhD

-Excellent research standing and publication record in the field of the position

-Teaching experience at university level and didactic competence

-Experience in the acquisition of and/or willingness to apply for competitive third-party research funding, depending on career progression

-Fluency in English

Desired qualifications:

-Experience in interdisciplinary collaboration

-Integration in the international scientific community

-Experience in (co-)supervision of academic theses

-Experience in academic self-administration

-Social skills, competence in leadership and management of teams

-Competence in gender mainstreaming and diversity management

-German skills or willingness to learn German

The salary is subject to negotiation. The minimum gross salary for the position at this level (salary group A1 for faculty according to the Austrian Universities' Collective Bargaining Agreement) is currently € 93,986 per year.

For full details of this vacancy and the specific application procedure, please see https://jobs.aau.at/en/job/full-professor-of-production-management/. 1 Converter Service Specialist - Technical Sales & Field Service (f/m/*) 
WHAT ARE MY RESPONSIBILITIES?

As a Converter Service Specialist (Technical Sales & Field Service) in our department Metallurgical Services (MS AT TI), you will be part of our growing Converter Services team - expanding Primetals Technologies' footprint in the global steelmaking market. You will act as both a technical expert and sales engineer: understanding customer needs, presenting our service solutions, and performing converter inspections, audits, and modernization activities on site. Your goal: turn technical know-how into customer value - by combining strong engineering expertise, hands-on field work, and proactive sales engagement.

Tasks and Responsibilities

 * Serve as the primary technical and technical-sales contact for converterrelated services (inspection, modernization, process audits, lifecycle management)
 * Conduct independent customer visits worldwide, presenting Primetals Technologies solutions and identifying new business opportunities
 * Perform on-site services, including mechanical inspections, condition assessments, and converter fitness checks
 * Prepare and coordinate technical offers for spare parts, inspections, and modernization projects
 * Analyze inspection results and prepare professional technical reports
 * Translate customer requirements into technical solutions and service concepts
 * Support modernization and upgrade planning, including spare parts and maintenance strategies
 * Cooperate closely with internal departments (engineering, sales, purchasing)
 * Execute supplier inspections and provide technical supervision during installation and commissioning
 * Prepare and deliver presentations and training sessions for internal teams and customers
 * Contribute to knowledge sharing and development within the converter services network

WHAT DO I NEED TO QUALIFY FOR THIS JOB?

 * Completed higher technical education (HTL/FH/University) in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, or related field
 * Several years of practical experience in converter operation, maintenance, or mechanical design - ideally from a steel plant environment
 * Proven hands-on experience and readiness to perform on-site work (inspection, measurement, supervision, commissioning)
 * Strong interest or proven experience in technical sales and customer relations
 * Good understanding of mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems
 * Basic knowledge of converter process and metallurgical principles advantageous
 * Knowledge of AutoCAD, NX (Unigraphics), technical drawings
 * Confident use of MS Office
 * Very good English skills, written and spoken
 * High willingness to travel internationally (approx. 20-30%)
 * Proactive, communicative, and solution-oriented personality

On a personal level you convince us with your analytical mindset, strong commercial awareness, and effective negotiation skills, complemented by a hands-on mentality. You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and represent Primetals Technologies with professionalism and confidence at customer sites.
WHAT ELSE DO I NEED TO KNOW?

The minimum annual gross salary for this position under the collective agreement and assuming that all requirements are met is EUR 47.546,94 (E/00). This could rise considerably, depending on qualifications and experience. Our Pioneers at Heart receive ongoing training in a wide range of areas through the "Metals Academy". In addition, we offer further benefits: From flexible working hours and home office options to free parking and discounted lunch menus. We also offer a voluntary sixth week of holiday from the age of 50.

HOW DO I APPLY?

If you are interested in this challenging and exciting position within an international environment, then submit your application online now:
https://jobs.primetals.com/Job/263371
